summary: Master Effective Delegation and Empowerment with the Skill-Will Matrix and SLII. Build high-performance teams, eliminate bottlenecks, and drive strategic result
lede: Delegation training helps experienced leaders and managers assign work according to team readiness and build ownership. It covers using the Skill-Will Matrix to assess capability and motivation, choosing an appropriate leadership approach, and guiding work through a staged delegation process. Participants also practise addressing resistance and setbacks without reverting to micromanagement, and designing empowerment plans that strengthen accountability.

prerequisites: Prerequisites: Participants must have at least 3 years of management experience with direct responsibility for team performance. A working understanding of basic leadership concepts (e.g., motivation, feedback) is required. No prior certification in Situational Leadership is necessary, but familiarity with the concept of 'leadership styles' is expected. This is an advanced-level course; beginners in management will find the pace too rapid and the concepts too abstract.
